_comment: OneMillion-Bench through a multi-agent workflow (workflow: reflection | parallel | pdr | single). Copy to onemillion-workflow.json and run: uv run python runs/run_onemillion_workflow.py <case-id> --dataset datasets/OneMillion-Bench/<domain> --profile runs/profiles/onemillion-workflow.json. Generator + judge creds stay in .env.

env._comment: Catalogued knobs read by the in-process generator (see docs/agent-native/configuration.md). Applied fill-the-gaps: a real export still wins.

run._comment: run_onemillion_workflow.py long options (without --). The workflow's shape (reflection-rounds, parallel-workers, timeout) maps to OMB_* inside the run. Defaults; an explicit CLI flag overrides.
